title: Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Shabbat 157a: the Rabbis attended to the son of Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira and annulled his vows, etc. Nedarim 77a reads “son of Rav Ze’ira.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman’s supplied wording refers to a son of Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira. The William Davidson Shabbat 157a paragraph instead has the rabbis attending to Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira himself and releasing his vows. This generation difference is preserved rather than harmonized.

The complete Shabbat 157a paragraph refers to Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira himself, whereas the complete Nedarim 77a paragraph refers to the son of Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira. Hyman’s wording and his Zeira/Ze’ira comparison remain visible; the differing generations are not harmonized.
